budget.stop_rule: stop and ask if a phase projects past 2x its Phase 0 estimate

revealed.decision_rule: R1 viable: lower Wilson bound of E1 >= 0.25 AND E2 >= 0.90 AND E1 point estimate > upper Wilson bound of the overall trivial baseline (mean over families of the majority-class rate; graph_reach majority read back from verdicts, undetermined tasks counted for the majority; other families 0). R2: if M2 and M1 both fail R1, record 'the strict small-weight class is too small for this suite'. R3: among R1 passers the highest E3; if E3 intervals overlap prefer plain attention, then Apache-2.0, then fewer parameters (proxy for peak memory), then higher E3, then model id. R4: a family where every model is above 0.95 or below 0.05, or where the reference program does not score 100%, is rescaled in a versioned suite before any claim. Computed by `cz analyze` exactly as built (binary hash in task_spec.artifacts).
revealed.failure_criteria: H1.1 fails if no arm meets R1. H1.2 fails if M2 does not meet R1. H1.3 fails if the E1 rank order differs from the vendor IFEval rank order. A ledger that fails verification, a replay that differs from live state, token totals that do not match the result JSON, or an exceeded cap voids the affected arm and is reported.
hypotheses: H1.1 At least one tested model reaches a lower 95% Wilson bound of 0.25 on the sealed suite with greedy decoding and at least 0.90 format validity.
H1.2 The strict small-weight model (Granite-4.0-H-350M) clears the same bar. If it does not, 'this weight class is too small for the suite' is the recorded result.
H1.3 Model rank by verified solve rate matches rank by vendor IFEval; a mismatch is reported, not explained away.
revealed.primary_endpoint: E1: verified solve rate on the sealed suite, greedy, with Wilson 95% interval, overall and per family and per (family, difficulty) cell. Secondary: E2 format validity (reason not starting 'format:'), E3 verified solves per million all-in tokens plus FLOP proxy 2 x params x tokens, E4 coverage@8, pairwise exact McNemar Holm-adjusted at 0.05. E5 resource profile comes from the Phase 0 record and the separate concurrency benchmark, not from this run.
